messages.subject: Error in nlminb
parts:
I am running a path model using R and when I try to calculate my model again only for a subsample of the whole sample I get the following error:

Error in nlminb(start = start.x, objective = minimize.this.function, gradient = GRADIENT,  : 
  NA/NaN gradient evaluation
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In lav_data_full(data = data, group = group, cluster = cluster,  :
  lavaan WARNING: exogenous variable(s) declared as ordered in data: any_affective_disorder any_anxiety_disorder OCD PTSD any_eating_disorder any_somatoform_disorder subakt solo past_treated
2: In muthen1984(Data = X[[g]], ov.names = ov.names[[g]], ov.types = ov.types,  :
  lavaan WARNING: trouble constructing W matrix; used generalized inverse for A11 submatrix
3: In nlminb(start = start.x, objective = minimize.this.function, gradient = GRADIENT,  :
  NA/NaN function evaluation

I don't get what the problem is as for the whole sample it was no problem to calculate it.

# Sensitivity analyses for problems and disorders seperate
#Final path model without lsg2 and direct path of "past_treated->curr_treat" (Sample=353)
model_final2.txt <- 'number_curr_axis_1 ~ any_affective_disorder + any_anxiety_disorder + OCD + PTSD + any_eating_disorder + any_somatoform_disorder + subakt
fct_deficit_curr ~ number_curr_axis_1
curr_treat ~ fct_deficit_curr + alter_a + solo + past_treated'

model_final2.fit <- sem(model_final2.txt, data = only_dis, control=list(iter.max=10000),verbose = TRUE)
summary(model_final2.fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
